source: https://moment.framer.photos via local mirror, computed-style probe @ 1440x900

primary.description: Display + body typeface for the entire site. all visible copy is Manrope.

monospace.source: fonts.gstatic.com (3 woff2 chunks for latin / latin-ext / cyrillic at /__mirror/https/fonts.gstatic.com/s/fragmentmono/v5/)
monospace.description: Loaded but NOT used in any visible copy on the captured routes. defined as the framer `code` block default. include for parity, but the rebuild can omit unless you add code blocks.
monospace.uncertainty: could be activated on a route we did not capture — the framer template ships with a code block style preset

fallbackInter.description: Inter is loaded as a framer-system fallback (rich text / blockquote defaults) but no measured node renders in Inter — Manrope wins for every visible class.

displayHero.usedFor: wordmark hero `moment` on home & in footer band; appears at the bottom-of-page cinematic display

tablet.fontSize: 160px (assumed — framer scales with content; not directly measured at tablet)

mobile.fontSize: scales down — could not measure, recommend 88-96px target

displayLargeBold.usedFor: primary section h1/h2: 'Moments I capture', 'Memories', 'Most viewed Pexels album', 'Studio journal', 'Let's have a chat', gallery index 'Memories'

displayLargeMedium.usedFor: journal article h1 (e.g. 'Photography for beginners') — slightly looser than the section heading variant

displayMediumBold.usedFor: h3 — 'Awards', testimonial blockquote, journal article cards, intro paragraph on home ('This portfolio is a visual diary…')

displayMediumMedium.usedFor: contact-cta email link 'kerrigan@hello.com' (h3) — display-tight version, single-line

headingLarge.usedFor: h4 — gallery card titles ('Spring Bloom', 'Prague'), about-page kicker ('I turn everyday moments…'), contact-page email h4

labelLargeBold.usedFor: nav 'menu' button (top-right), inline page-level toggles — visually a tight bold label

bodyLargeMedium.usedFor: journal article body paragraphs ('Let's be honest — photography…')

bodyDefaultBold.usedFor: card meta-bold ('Shot in', author byline lead), most prominent body class — 59 instances

bodyDefaultRegular.usedFor: compact byline 'By Henry Kerrigan', tight inline labels — 54 instances

navMicro.usedFor: raw nav text containers — not a final visible style; the rendered 'menu' label inside reads at 28px/600. this row is the UA-default sans-serif on the nav wrapper element.
navMicro.uncertainty: this is a wrapper computed style; not authored by framer. ignore for type scale purposes.

scaleNotes: exactly 13 distinct authored type scales surface across the captured routes (the 14th, 'navMicro', is wrapper-level UA default and not real).
no `text-transform: uppercase` anywhere — uppercase strings are uppercase in source.
no italics in measured nodes (italic Inter faces are loaded but unused on these routes).
letter-spacing tightens proportionally with size: ~-0.02em on 64-160px display; normal on 12-45px text.
line-height pattern: 1.0 (160px hero, 45px h3-medium, tight 16px), 1.2 (64px section), 1.4-1.5 (32px h4, 20px body, 16px body), 1.71 (14px footer micro).
every heading is fontWeight 500 OR 600 — never 700+; framer template stays in Manrope's medium/semibold range.
Fragment Mono is loaded but not used. Inter is loaded as a framer fallback but not rendered.
notes: responsive variants beyond desktop (1440) were not measured directly. framer media queries split at 940px and 1439px — expect mobile/tablet to scale displayHero (160px) and displayLargeBold (64px) down. recommended phase-3 targets if not re-measured: hero 160→112→88, h2 64→48→40, h3 45→36→32.
